risk_explanation: The project is pinned to idna 2.10, which was released over six years ago and is significantly behind the latest version 3.20. The package is not directly imported in the project's source code and is only present as a transitive dependency of requests. Removing the pin allows the package manager to resolve a modern, secure version compatible with requests.
steps: Remove the idna==2.10 pin from requirements.txt to allow requests to use a current, compatible version of the library.
suggested_tests: Run pytest to ensure that requests continues to function correctly with the updated version of idna.
